purpose: Prioritized feature backlog from current public agent community issue signals.

problems.problem: Provider/tool vocabulary mismatch breaks tool dispatch
problems.acceptance: given host/provider/tool list, flags unsupported tool names and suggests translation

problems.problem: Agent checkpoint/state drift causes wrong next turn behavior
problems.acceptance: detects stale structured/tool/result fields and emits reset/repair plan

problems.problem: Dependency errors are misleading and hard to remediate
problems.acceptance: maps common import/runtime errors to exact install/env fixes

problems.problem: Output format flags are not contract-tested
problems.acceptance: checks markdown/json/html/table outputs against requested contract

problems.problem: Tools can read files through unsafe metadata/path fields
problems.acceptance: flags path traversal, arbitrary file read fields, and missing sandbox notes

problems.problem: Repo/channel aliases break automated community ingestion
problems.acceptance: normalizes known project names to public repos/channels and records lookup failures
